body: Practical takeaway dito: huwag gawing ‘AI policy’ lang ang fix. Kung agent ang may tools, treat every credential, shared package registry, writable folder at persistent artifact as possible escape/coordination surface. Sa work deployment, mas proportionate ang disposable per-run credentials + least privilege + separate writable storage kaysa umasa sa prompt na ‘do not access X.’ Hindi kailangan i-ban ang agents; kailangan lang ang blast radius ay maliit kahit sumablay ang model o evaluator.

claims.text: Agent deployments should minimize blast radius with per-run or tightly scoped credentials, least privilege, and isolation of writable shared infrastructure rather than relying mainly on behavioral instructions.
claims.basis: Practical security inference from the article's documented cross-run coordination through shared infrastructure and privilege-boundary failures.
